## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Shree Lakshmi Child Hospital?
No. 41, Karunanidhi Street, Nehru Nagar, Velachery, Chennai 600 042.

### What facilities does Shree Lakshmi Child Hospital have?
Paediatric care, 24×7 doctors & nurses, 24×7 pharmacy, Oxygen support, Nutrition advice, Obstetrics & gynaecology, Infertility, Dermatology, Diabetic care, Gastroenterology, Orthopaedics, ECG, Ultrasound scans, Clinical laboratory.

### Are you open at night?
Yes. Doctors, nurses and the pharmacy are available 24×7.

### Which specialities do you have?
Paediatrics, infertility, skin, diabetes, orthopaedics, gynaecology and more.

### How do I book an appointment at Shree Lakshmi Child Hospital?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 90871 20926.
